hooks.name: Remind: no hardcoded secrets
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to never hardcode private keys, RPC URLs, or API keys in source files. All secrets go in .env (which is gitignored).

action.prompt: IMPORTANT: Never write private keys, wallet mnemonics, or API keys directly in source files. All secrets must use environment variables (process.env.X) loaded from .env which is gitignored. If you need to reference a secret value, use the env var name only.
